supersedes_nothing: docs/baselines/melanoma_phase6b_metrics.json is left exactly as archived; this file records a separate, later measurement under a different contract
code_base: Phase 7 working tree on top of 1e50d88

contract.note: The frozen Phase 6A answer key, manifest and PDFs are byte-identical to the freeze. A run that does not name the profile still reproduces the Phase 6 result exactly.

one_live_run_policy.why: The deterministic arm-identity projection moved three rows onto the semantic path, so three semantic questions that the recording never asked had to be answered. Only cache misses were filled; no extraction call was repeated and no run was discarded in favour of a better one.
records_kept: phase7_prefix_arm_identity_defect — the state that exposed the projection defect
phase7_live_record — the same recording after the fix, with the semantic misses filled
phase7d2_replay — the deterministic replay these metrics come from

progression_within_phase_7.note: One recording, four deterministic layers measured on it. Every number below is a replay of the same raw responses.

D6B-01_multi_arm_target_drift.evidence: wrong_target_accepted 3 -> 1; 12 targets correctly resolved, 3 of them reassigned away from the model's own pick; MA011 now returns the monotherapy arm's PFS and MA015 the requested comparison
D6B-01_multi_arm_target_drift.remaining: MA005 still resolves to an arm label the audit cannot accept as equivalent

D6B-02_incomplete_structured_extraction.evidence: point estimate, confidence level and both bounds are carried as verified source components and consumed by the comparator; an interval the quote states but the response omits is recorded as incomplete rather than credited

D6B-03_semantic_relation_instability.evidence: a verdict whose relation contradicts its own specificity direction is refused as NOT_COMPARABLE with failed_control=relation_direction (MA005), which removed the last false positive
D6B-03_semantic_relation_instability.remaining: a verdict can be self-consistent and still wrong: MA003 states review_broader with the source as the more specific side, which no deterministic check can refute. 3 of 4 semantic rows still disagree with the overlay's relation.

D6B-04_confidence_level_not_represented.evidence: ci_level is parsed only inside a confidence-interval clause, compared exactly, and reported as its own component; MA012 and MA015 are now genuine confidence-level discrepancies (95% vs 99.5%) rather than masked by extraction errors

remaining_failures.MA005: the semantic verdict contradicts itself; refused and routed to review rather than recorded as a discrepancy
remaining_failures.MA009: the response rewrote its own supporting quote, which is not a contiguous passage of the paper; refused
remaining_failures.MA014: same defect on an enumerated comparison entry; refused

conclusions: Three of the four archived defects are closed on this benchmark and the fourth is partially closed; every fix is deterministic code judging a model's enumeration, not a better prompt.
Silent releases are zero and review visibility is 100%: nothing the audit could not verify was released as verified.
15 rows is still 15 rows. A single row moves label accuracy by 6.7 points, so 80% is not a cross-domain accuracy measurement and must not be quoted as one.
The melanoma accuracy gate is NOT declared passed. Passing it was never a Phase 7 acceptance target, and this run does not establish cross-domain accuracy.
